physics_workflow: Heat Transfer in Fluids: establish a uniform or imported background temperature
Pressure Acoustics: use c(T)=sqrt(gamma*R*T) and solve the eigenfrequency response
Use Thermoviscous Acoustics only when boundary-layer losses are part of the question

boundaries.thermal_condition: uniform background temperature for the reference case

acceptance: Eigenfrequency follows the c(T)/(2L) trend for uniform-temperature sweeps
A report distinguishes pressure-acoustics results from thermoviscous or feedback-inclusive thermoacoustics
Boundary-layer thickness is compared with tube radius before selecting a loss model
